fundraising_strategy: Retain the modeled $250 standard ticket as the planning baseline. Ask the board to consider sponsor-funded community tickets and an optional supporter tier; prices and allocations remain undecided and should be modeled before adoption.

Draft sponsorship asks for event underwriting, community-ticket access and speaker-program support. Seek written commitments rather than treating historical sponsorship assumptions as secured revenue.

Include a brief, voluntary paddle raise after the mission presentation, with a discreet way to give. Keep the recovery speaker’s contribution separate from any expectation to solicit donations or disclose more than they wish.
Seek in-kind catering, AV and event-support contributions where permitted. Do not count potential donations as cost savings until confirmed and reflected in updated calculator results.

Use the supplied $31,442.50 base net and $16,337 conservative net to frame fundraising discussions. Additional fundraising is needed to reach $40,000; do not promise that ticket tiers or sponsorship ideas will close the gap.
logistics_notes: Confirm availability for 2027-04-17 and obtain written terms before any board commitment.
Load-in is permitted only after 4 pm. Confirm sufficient setup, catering and sound-check time before setting guest arrival and program times.
Plan around 150 guests within the published reception capacity of 200. Ask for the catering guest-count deadline and lock the count before that deadline.
Respect the standing-receptions-only restriction. Ask whether rest seating and seating accommodations are permitted; do not assume a seated dinner or seated program is possible.
Ask about step-free entry, accessible restrooms, stage access, dietary accommodations, sound levels and a quieter space. None of these accessibility features is confirmed for Chelsea Atelier.
Assign volunteer roles for welcome, guest introductions, speaker liaison, accessibility requests and donation assistance. Confirm microphone and other AV needs rather than assuming they are included.

recommendation.headline: Advance Chelsea Atelier for inquiry only; resolve accessibility, funding and the fundraising target before committing.
recommendation.recommendation: For the proposed 150-person Manhattan Spring Gala on April 17, 2027, pursue Chelsea Atelier’s reception as the sole supplied venue option within the $18,000 cost ceiling. Its preliminary cost is $15,400, with $4,250 needed upfront. Finance finds it affordable with conditions—not authorized. A warm reception honoring Sabrina, with a short, consent-led recovery talk, fits the intended program, but the standing-only format presents a material inclusion concern. Do not commit until seating accommodations and accessibility are confirmed, unrestricted cash is verified, and the board addresses the fundraising-target shortfall.
rationale: Chelsea’s supplied reception capacity is 200 for the planned 150 guests. Outside catering is permitted, no food-and-beverage minimum is stated, and a small speaker stage supports the program. All venue details remain synthetic and unconfirmed.

Preliminary expense budget: venue $1,800; catering $8,700; entertainment $1,500; marketing $600; staffing $900; insurance and permits $500; miscellaneous $0. Supplied subtotal: $14,000; contingency: $1,400; total: $15,400. The miscellaneous allowance does not establish that no additional costs will arise.

The $4,250 upfront requirement passes the supplied model’s check against $9,938 of planning capacity above the $11,562 reserve floor. That capacity must be verified as unrestricted cash still available when payments are due. Recorded income, projected ticket receipts, restricted funds and pledged sponsorship are not available deposit money.

At the modeled $250 standard ticket, the base case assumes 150 attendees, $37,500 in ticket revenue, $5,000 in sponsorship and $4,342.50 in donations. Supplied total revenue is $46,842.50 and net proceeds are $31,442.50. Sponsorship and demand are unconfirmed.

The conservative case assumes 120 attendees, $31,737 in total revenue and $16,337 in net proceeds. Optimistic net proceeds are $35,245.25. None of the supplied net scenarios reaches $40,000; the board must clarify whether that goal means gross revenue or net proceeds.

Unsent venue inquiry draft
To: Chelsea Atelier (synthetic; verified contact needed)
Subject: Inquiry: Manhattan Spring Gala on April 17, 2027

Hello,

The Sabrina Audrey Milone Foundation is exploring a reception-style fundraising gala for 150 guests in Manhattan on April 17, 2027. We envision a warm, personal evening honoring Sabrina, with a brief tribute and a short recovery-speaker talk.

Could you confirm availability, capacity and current itemized pricing, including required fees, deposit and payment schedules, cancellation terms, insurance and permit requirements? Please also confirm outside-catering rules and whether any food-and-beverage minimum applies.

We understand the proposed format is standing-only. Can you permit sufficient seating accommodations for guests who cannot stand for extended periods? Please describe accessible entry, restrooms and stage access, along with dietary accommodation options and the possibility of a quieter area. We would also appreciate details on the speaker stage, AV equipment and staffing requirements.

Please share these details so our board can assess suitability and affordability. This is an exploratory inquiry, not a booking or commitment.

Thank you.
Replace placeholder entertainment, marketing, staffing, insurance and permit estimates with quotes; enter known miscellaneous costs and rerun finance if costs or accommodations change.
Verify unrestricted cash, the restricted cash balance and payment timing before considering deposits. Do not count pledged sponsorship as available money.
Seek documented sponsorship terms and payment timing; model community-ticket access and supporter tiers before adoption. Count in-kind savings only after confirmation and an updated budget.

Confirm the recovery speaker’s participation, consent boundaries, introduction preferences and technical needs. Plan volunteer welcomes, optional introductions, a brief tribute, the short talk and an optional, discreet paddle raise.
Return the verified plan to the board for its fundraising-goal decision and any spending authorization.

mission_contribution.inclusion: Sponsor-funded community tickets could make participation possible beyond guests able to pay $250. The board should review both the ticket barrier and the standing-only format before proceeding.
